_comment: The tools bengkel hosts. Adding a fourth is an entry here, not a code
The order here is the order of the pipeline, and it is the order they
appear on the rail: find it, make it, clean it up, dress it, check it, move
it. A tool added in the middle goes in the middle.
Each tool is a local server and a page, started by bengkel and stopped
with it. `ready` is the line the server prints when it is listening; it
carries the port it settled on and that run's token, because neither is
`noOpen` is the flag that stops the tool opening a browser of its own —
they disagree about the spelling, which is exactly the sort of thing a
config file should absorb rather than a program remember.

tools.name: pasar
tools.blurb: Sketchfab, Poly Haven and Texturelabs from one search box. What you bring home lands in the workshop.

tools.name: boneka
tools.blurb: Type what you want and watch Blender build it, part by part. One button gives it a skeleton.

tools.name: jaring
tools.blurb: Turn a half-million-triangle download into something a game can carry, with its detail baked into a normal map.

tools.name: kulit
tools.blurb: Give every part of a model a colour and say what it is made of. Real maps, not a flat slab.

tools.name: periksa
tools.blurb: A last look before a model goes into a game: its size, its origin, its weight, its UVs. It reads the file rather than opening it.

tools.name: gerak
tools.blurb: Click a joint, turn it, key the pose. FK and IK, and a timeline that works out the frames between.
